# T.I.T.S. sub-actions

## Activate trigger

Starts a T.I.T.S. trigger, which throws items at your avatar the way you set it up in T.I.T.S.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Trigger** | The trigger's name or id from T.I.T.S. |

<small>Type id: `tits.activateTrigger`</small>

## Activate trigger by name

Starts a T.I.T.S. trigger by its name, which throws items at your avatar the way you set it up in T.I.T.S.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Trigger** | The trigger's name exactly as T.I.T.S. shows it. |

<small>Type id: `tits.activateTriggerByName`</small>

## Get items

Reads the list of items T.I.T.S. can throw and keeps it for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.items%` | The list of items (id and name) as raw text |
| `%tits.itemCount%` | How many items there are |

<small>Type id: `tits.getItems`</small>

## Get triggers

Reads the list of T.I.T.S. triggers and keeps it for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.triggers%` | The list of triggers (id and name) as raw text |
| `%tits.triggerCount%` | How many triggers there are |

<small>Type id: `tits.getTriggers`</small>

## Throw item

Throws one kind of item at your avatar, one or more times.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Item** | The item's name or id from T.I.T.S. |
| **Delay between throws (seconds)** | How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05. Starts as: `0.05`. |
| **Amount** | How many items to throw in total. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.thrownItems%` | How many items T.I.T.S. threw |

<small>Type id: `tits.throwItem`</small>

| **Amount** | How many items to throw in total. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

## Throw items

Throws random items from a list at your avatar. Each throw picks one item from your list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Items** | The items to pick from (names or ids), one per line or separated by commas. |
| **Delay between throws (seconds)** | How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05. Starts as: `0.05`. |
| **Amount** | How many items to throw in total. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.thrownItems%` | How many items T.I.T.S. threw |

<small>Type id: `tits.throwItems`</small>

## Throw items by name

Throws random items, picked from a list of names, at your avatar. Each throw picks one item from your list.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Items** | The item names to pick from, one per line or separated by commas. |
| **Delay between throws (seconds)** | How many seconds to wait between throws. T.I.T.S. normally uses 0.05. Starts as: `0.05`. |
| **Amount** | How many items to throw in total. Starts as: `1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%tits.thrownItems%` | How many items T.I.T.S. threw |

<small>Type id: `tits.throwItemsByName`</small>
